answer: Trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph; for a sybil set S in a weighted undirected graph, conductance φ(S)=cut(S,V\\S)/vol(S) measures its sparse external boundary. From a stationary walk conditioned in S, the probability of escaping within t steps is at most tφ(S), limiting honest-seed reach and, with capped per-identity stake, aggregate voting weight. A sonnet, marble, or bridge label cannot alter this cut-based bound.
